title: Apologies and Prepositions (2/2)
summaryZh: 示範道歉的各種說法，並用電影對白說明道歉是否真誠。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Everyday Grammar

sentences.zh: 你應該向 Sasha 道歉。

sentences.text: You should not take her toys.
sentences.zh: 你不應該拿走她的玩具。

sentences.text: Finally, we can use the word apologize alone.
sentences.zh: 最後，apologize 這個字也可以單獨使用。

sentences.text: An internet company made a mistake and sent out this message to their customers.
sentences.zh: 有一家網路公司出了錯，發了這則訊息給他們的客戶。

sentences.text: Sometimes people say they are sorry, but we do not believe they really feel bad for saying or doing the wrong thing.
sentences.zh: 有時候別人說抱歉，但我們並不覺得他們真的為說錯話或做錯事感到愧疚。

sentences.text: Here is an example from a popular movie of an apology that may not be sincere.
sentences.zh: 以下是一部熱門電影裡的例子，這個道歉可能並不真誠。

sentences.text: In the comedy film A Fish Called Wanda, John Cleese plays Archie Leach and Kevin Kline plays Otto.
sentences.zh: 在喜劇電影《笨賊一籮筐》裡，John Cleese 飾演 Archie Leach，Kevin Kline 飾演 Otto。

sentences.text: Otto becomes angry with Archie for saying Otto is crazy.
sentences.zh: Archie 說 Otto 瘋了，Otto 因此很生氣。

sentences.text: As Otto holds Archie by his feet upside down from a window, Archie must apologize.
sentences.zh: Otto 抓著 Archie 的腳，把他從窗口倒吊出去，Archie 只好道歉。

sentences.text: All right, all right, I apologize.
And I hereby undertake not to repeat any such slander at any time in the future.
sentences.zh: 我在此保證，以後絕不再說任何類似的毀謗。

sentences.text: Now, do you really believe Archie means what he is saying?
sentences.zh: 那麼，你真的相信 Archie 說的是真心話嗎？
